description: Dependency updates of web-check, run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml, on top of the shared preset KevinDeBenedetti/renovate-config: Monday-morning pull requests (Europe/Paris), nothing published less than 3 days ago, OSV security updates that never wait, actions and images pinned to their digest, weekly lock file maintenance. Renovate reads this file from main only: a change here takes effect once it is merged there.

packageRules.description: Every update is a `chore(deps)` (`ci(deps)` for the actions, below), never config:recommended's `fix(deps)`: release-please hides `chore`, so a dependency bump cuts no release on its own.
Python: move uv.lock only, and touch pyproject.toml when a release falls outside a declared range (the upper bounds on sqlalchemy and sqlmap).
Python minor and patch updates (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) in one pull request a week. Majors come one per pull request (the preset's separateMultipleMajorReleases).
Web UI minor and patch updates (apps/web/package.json and package-lock.json) in one pull request a week.
The Vite toolchain only works on one major: its majors come together.
React and its types move on one major together.
The base images of the Dockerfile (node web-build stage, uv + Python API stage) in one pull request: tags, digests and digest pins.
The scanner images of docker-compose.yml (zap, nuclei, nikto, ffuf): minors, patches and digests in one pull request; a major gets its own.

The actions of .github/workflows in one pull request, as `ci(deps)` (the `chore` rule above would otherwise override the preset's `ci`). The reusable workflows of github-workflows stay on @main: the preset leaves them alone.
Node.js majors are switched by hand to the next LTS line, in the web-build stage of the Dockerfile and node-version of ci-cd.yml in the same commit (an odd major is never LTS).
The Python runtime is moved by hand, everywhere at once: .python-version, requires-python, python-version in ci-cd.yml and the python3.12 tag of the uv image (whose suffix Renovate keeps as is).
ghcr.io gives no release date, which the preset's 3-day minimumReleaseAge would take as never old enough: the uv image would never move.
